s.n: Lettuce leaf chicken and rice cups
s.note: the Abbotts serve dinner on leaves, no clattering plates
s.how: Poach 500g chicken breast in simmering salted water for 15 minutes, rest, then shred. Cook 200g jasmine rice. Mix the juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar and 1 sliced red chilli. Separate 2 butter lettuces into cups. Fill each with rice, chicken, sliced Lebanese cucumber, mint and coriander, spoon over the dressing and finish with 50g crushed roasted peanuts.
Brush 4 soft pretzels with butter, sprinkle with coarse salt and warm at 200C for 5 minutes. Heat 375ml evaporated milk and stir in 200g grated cheddar until smooth. Serve warm, and dip quietly.

m.note: caught at the river by the waterfall where they can talk
m.how: Stuff 2 whole trout with lemon slices, dill and sliced garlic. Dot with 40g butter and wrap each in foil. Bake at 200C for 18 minutes and open at the table. Boil 800g new potatoes and toss with butter.

w.how: Poach 2 peeled, halved pears in sugar syrup for 15 minutes. Whisk 4 yolks, 80g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour. Pour over 400ml hot milk and 100ml cream, then stir over low heat until thick. Add vanilla, chill in cups and top with the pears.

d.note: the waterfall, the one place they can speak
d.how: Shave 1 Lebanese cucumber into ribbons with a peeler. Lightly crush a handful of mint with the juice of 2 limes and 60ml elderflower cordial in a jug. Add the cucumber and 1L chilled sparkling water slowly. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice rather than cubes so they stay quiet, pour over and top with a mint sprig.
